cues.en: Latency and throughput are obviously related. Latency is how long it takes you from the start of doing a particular thing to when you get the result of that thing back. And the reason that this matters is because it accounts for overlap.
cues.zh: 延迟和吞吐量显然相关。延迟是从开始做某件事到拿回结果所需的时间。吞吐量类似延迟，但不是只衡量取回某个结果所需的总时间，而是问：之后每多做一件，成本是多少？这之所以重要，是因为它考虑了重叠。

cues.en: So your throughput can be much faster than your latency because if something you know if it takes you one minute to do something That's a pretty long latency, but if it takes one minute to do it But every second you can start doing another one and stack up as many as you want
